tickets.title: Add money edge-case tests
tickets.outcome: The frontend format tests cover zero, one cent and ninety-nine cent amounts.
tickets.acceptance: Create exactly product/frontend/tests/money_edge_test.ts. Import money from ../lib/format.ts and assert money(0).includes('0.00'), money(1).includes('0.01') and money(99).includes('0.99') are all true. Do not modify production code or existing tests. The full product suite passes.
tickets.constraints: Add one frontend test file only; no production behavior change.

tickets.title: Add short date edge-case tests
tickets.outcome: The frontend format tests cover a plain date, a timestamp and an empty value.
tickets.acceptance: Create exactly product/frontend/tests/short_date_edge_test.ts. Import shortDate from ../lib/format.ts and assert shortDate('2026-10-22') === '2026-10-22', shortDate('2026-10-22T23:59:59Z') === '2026-10-22' and shortDate('') === '—'. Do not modify production code or existing tests. The full product suite passes.

tickets.title: Add mergeable edge-case tests
tickets.outcome: The frontend format tests cover empty pulls, approved pulls and merged pulls.
tickets.acceptance: Create exactly product/frontend/tests/mergeable_edge_test.ts. Import mergeable from ../lib/format.ts and assert mergeable({}) === false, mergeable({status:'OPEN', checks:{tests:{passed:1,total:1}}, review:{verdict:'ok'}}) === true, mergeable({status:'APPROVED', checks:{tests:{passed:1,total:1}}, review:{verdict:'OK'}}) === true and mergeable({status:'MERGED', checks:{tests:{passed:1,total:1}}, review:{verdict:'OK'}}) === false. Do not modify production code or existing tests. The full product suite passes.
